notes.title: v1.0.1 patch update
notes.content:
Patch notes:

- Improved start instruction to help new players understand how to play.
- Fixed artefacts to be not be collectable once you collect them initially.
- Can now press E or F to open doors.
- Holding "Tab" in-game highlights objective count.
- Fixed best time not appearing in main menu.
- Made painting puzzle sounds slower and lower pitch so they are easier to workout.
- Made Jukebox puzzle easier on normal difficulty.
- Made it so in-game timer doesn't show in "Is Betty There" as it has no effect to player time.
- Added key icon when completing objective.
- Added brain image next to sanity timer so players can identify it as sanity.

Thank you very much everyone!
More to come!

Lewis & Jackson.
